name: IC Analog — Texas
description: Analog IC cluster containing 3 surface-mount parts across quality tiers A and B using Texas package family footprints.
selection_hints: Select when requiring SMD analog ICs such as switches, DACs, or comparators using Texas package footprints.
Choose Tier A part TS3A24159DRC for S-PVSON-N10 or Tier B parts for S-PDSO-G8 and X2SON-6 footprints.

avoid_when: Do not use when through-hole mounting is required.
Avoid if the board layout requires footprints outside the Texas package family.
Do not use for components outside the analog IC category.
